homepage.products.toy.title.message: Toys that talk, with a personality of their own.

homepage.products.toy.description.message: Hear what children say, respond in character, and bring each reply to life with voice and device actions.

homepage.products.toy.prompt.message: "Tell me a story about going to the moon."
homepage.products.toy.prompt.description: AI 玩具场景示例提示词

homepage.products.toy.hardware.message: Hardware: microphone, speaker, and status light. Firmware handles capture, playback, and local feedback.

homepage.products.toy.step.upload.message: The device captures speech and uploads it through the SDK.

homepage.products.toy.step.generate.message: The cloud recognizes speech and creates a story and voice response in character.

homepage.products.toy.step.play.message: The device plays the reply while firmware controls the status light.

homepage.products.camera.description.message: Combine visual understanding with spoken explanations, bringing the camera, screen, and speaker together for photo-based learning.

homepage.products.camera.prompt.description: 拍学设备场景示例提示词

homepage.products.camera.hardware.message: Hardware: camera, screen, and speaker. Firmware handles photos, uploads, display, and playback.

homepage.products.camera.step.upload.message: The device takes a photo and uploads it through the SDK.

homepage.products.camera.step.explain.message: The cloud interprets the image and generates a relevant explanation.

homepage.products.camera.step.present.message: The screen shows the result while the speaker plays the explanation.

homepage.products.assistant.title.message: Turn spoken words into device actions.

homepage.products.assistant.description.message: From understanding speech to executing tools, let a room assistant operate device features you have connected and authorized.

homepage.products.assistant.prompt.message: "Turn on the reading light and set the brightness to 60%."
homepage.products.assistant.prompt.description: 空间助手场景示例提示词

homepage.products.assistant.hardware.message: Hardware: voice input and local tools. Cross-device control also requires device binding, permissions, and platform services.

homepage.products.assistant.step.underst.message: The device uploads speech, and AI identifies the device and action.

homepage.products.assistant.step.match.message: AI selects an authorized tool and generates brightness control parameters.

homepage.products.assistant.step.execute.message: The device executes locally, returns the result, and announces completion.

homepage.products.efficiency.description.message: Bring AI into the workplace with desktop or portable devices that capture, understand, retrieve knowledge, and organize tasks.

homepage.products.efficiency.prompt.message: "Summarize the meeting and list the owners and deadlines."
homepage.products.efficiency.prompt.description: AI 效率场景示例提示词

homepage.products.efficiency.hardware.message: Hardware: microphone, screen, or camera. Connect enterprise knowledge bases, business tools, and your own services as needed.

homepage.products.efficiency.step.captur.message: The device captures the meeting and builds structured context.

homepage.products.efficiency.step.extrac.message: The Agent uses knowledge and task rules to extract action items.

homepage.products.efficiency.step.write.message: Open interfaces send the items to your workflow for user confirmation.

homepage.embedded.cloud.title.message: Keep AI in the cloud and devices lean

homepage.embedded.cloud.text.message: Keep capture, playback, protocols, and local control on the device. Offload complex inference to the cloud as needed for a complete AI experience within limited RAM and Flash.

homepage.embedded.cloud.code.description: 嵌入式设计原则关键词

homepage.embedded.pal.title.message: Isolate chip differences with the PAL

homepage.embedded.pal.text.message: The PAL abstracts networking, threads, time, and storage. Change chips or operating systems without rewriting your business logic alongside the platform code.

homepage.embedded.pal.code.message: PAL / Port once / Keep your logic
homepage.embedded.pal.code.description: 嵌入式设计原则关键词

homepage.embedded.network.title.message: Keep interactions flowing on poor networks

homepage.embedded.network.text.message: Build a real-time link for audio, images, video, text, and events, with handling for streaming, interruptions, reconnection, and network fluctuations.

homepage.embedded.network.code.description: 嵌入式设计原则关键词

homepage.embedded.execution.title.message: Let the device decide what runs

homepage.embedded.execution.text.message: AI sends tool requests as MCP commands. Local firmware decides whether to execute, performs the action, and returns the result.

homepage.embedded.execution.code.description: 嵌入式设计原则关键词

homepage.algorithms.device.text.message: On-device solutions can provide keyword wake-up and visual preprocessing. Run VAD on the device or in the cloud to suit your product.

homepage.algorithms.cloud.title.message: Cloud algorithms that keep improving the experience.

homepage.algorithms.cloud.text.message: Send audio, images, and video to cloud algorithms over a real-time link and receive text, speech, or structured results.

homepage.algorithms.vertical.title.message: Specialized algorithms for the real world.

homepage.algorithms.vertical.text.message: Continuously optimized for real device challenges: far-field audio, competing speakers, individual pet recognition, and complex scenes.

homepage.algorithms.vertical.chips.message: Speech models · Audio models · Vision models

homepage.choices.tuyaopen.text.message: Tuya's standardized layered framework, with open source code and a broad set of AI and IoT components.

homepage.choices.agenticKit.text.message: Keep your existing stack and design choices. Select only what you need for resource-constrained or deeply customized products.

homepage.hero.description.message: From low-compute MCUs and Linux SoCs to PCs, mobile apps, and browsers. Connect voice toys, embodied robots, and more through one real-time device-to-cloud integration, adding perception, Agents, memory, and models as needed.
